parole.significato: Often in the plural form blandishments: a flattering speech or action designed to influence or persuade.
parole.testo: From blandish (“to persuade someone by using flattery, to cajole; to praise someone dishonestly, to flatter or butter up”) + -ment (suffix forming nouns from verbs, having the sense of ‘the action or result of what is denoted by the verbs’).
